articles.title: ATLASSIAN'S AI MARKETING PLAYBOOK FOR CAMPAIGNS, CREATIVE PRODUCTION & REPORTING
articles.summary:
AI can draft a brief and content in minutes. But campaigns still take weeks to launch, creative gets trapped in revision cycles, and reporting takes hours to pull together.

ATLASSIAN'S AI MARKETING PLAYBOOK [5] is a practical guide to making AI deliver for marketing, where you'll learn how to:

* Build stronger campaign plans, move into execution faster, and maintain momentum as priorities change. * Increase creative capacity while protecting time for ideas, craft, and quality. * Move from performance signals to decisions and action sooner.

You'll also get a practical framework for choosing a high-value workflow [6] to transform, piloting it on real work, and measuring the impact.

articles.title: MARKETERS TO SPEND $116 BILLION ON CREATORS IN 2026
articles.summary: Brand spending on creators is forecast to grow 15% in 2026 and reach $178 billion by 2030, about twice the pace of advertising. Paid amplification of creator content makes up 44% of spending, while paying creators for content rather than reach is the fastest-growing segment. Most of the growth comes from budgets shifted out of TV, performance media, and creative production rather than new marketing dollars.

articles.title: 94% OF GLOBAL HITS WENT VIRAL ON TIKTOK FIRST, REVEALS 2026 MUSIC IMPACT REPORT
articles.summary: TikTok has become a major driver of music discovery and commercial success. 94% of songs that entered the Billboard Global 200 in 2025 went viral on the platform first. Songs that go viral on TikTok spend four times longer on the chart than non-viral tracks, and 45% of US TikTok users discover new music on the platform. That discovery also translates into purchases: TikTok music listeners are 78% more likely to pay for a streaming subscription, and 61% purchased physical or digital music in the past year.

articles.title: 5 TIPS TO INCREASING LINKEDIN VIDEO REACH
articles.summary: With LinkedIn reach declining, prioritize timely topics tied to current conversations and use on-screen text hooks that create curiosity rather than simply describe the video. Keep footage clear and audio crisp without overcomplicating production. Focus on content that offers value viewers can apply or save. Listicles and self-improvement formats are gaining traction. Avoid excessive transitions and visual effects that distract from the message.

articles.title: WIN REPORT: HOW CUTTING OVERWHELM GREW CONVERSIONS BY 13%
articles.summary: Reducing the effort required to compare options can increase conversions, especially when a page overwhelms visitors with too much information. Churnet Valley Railway replaced its long list of eight dining experiences with categorized sections that put popular options first and compact cards that made prices, departure times, and durations easy to compare. It also replaced the “Book Now” CTA with “Check Running Times” to give visitors a lower-commitment next step into the booking process. The redesign increased conversions by 13%, with an even stronger result among first-time visitors.

articles.title: 5 WAYS TO PERSONALIZE YOUR EMAILS, FROM A STUDY OF 274 BILLION SENDS
articles.summary: Personalize emails by referencing shoppers' recent activity, such as products they browsed, items in their cart, or their last purchase. Use signup preferences to tailor welcome emails, and include product-specific care tips, how-to content, or complementary product recommendations in post-purchase emails. Show/hide logic can also display different content to different segments in a single campaign, such as VIP offers for loyalty members or location-specific promotions. Klaviyo's analysis of 274 billion emails found that messages that referenced shoppers' recent activity earned 45% higher click rates in flows and 33% higher click rates in campaigns.

articles.title: THE AI AD CREATIVE MASTERCLASS: SKILLS, TOOLS, AND THE 21 FORMATS TOP BRANDS RUN
articles.summary: 24 of the 34 longest-running Meta ads from 48 top DTC brands were simple stills. Creator videos were the most tested video format but among the first switched off, with a median run of 38 days. Strong batches mix at least 4 formats and 3 buying angles, with stills built to run for months and videos replaced every few weeks.
